== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|[[Force]] [[aura]] is a type of power that can be utilized through various techniques to enhance physical actions or manipulate the environment. It is closely related to [[sword aura]], which serves as a specific adaptation of force, though the two are distinct. Practitioners can use force [[aura]] to augment physical strength, such as when pushing heavy objects or maintaining balance while carrying immense weight. It can also be applied to combat, allowing a user to fly through the air by kicking against it or to project power through strikes. Additionally, force [[aura]] can be combined with other elements, such as [[blood]] or [[wind]], to exert greater control over a situation.}}
